_comment: TS↔Rust shared constants — parity by fixture, never by codegen or source scraping. Each entry declares its source of truth; hand-written tests on BOTH sides (src-tauri/src/parity_tests.rs via include_str!, src/lib/parity.test.ts via the real TS modules) assert their named constants equal these values, so a one-sided edit fails cargo test or bun test. scripts/check-parity.mjs (in the lint chain) validates this file's shape and that every entry key is referenced by both suites. endpointLocality is behavioral: the two implementations stay independent (security policy is never shared across the boundary) and the fixture pins the agreed verdicts.

memexPerms.sourceOfTruth: src/lib/tauri.ts MemexPerms union ↔ src-tauri/src/memex.rs MemexPerms enum serde wire strings

frontmatterView.sourceOfTruth: src/lib/tauri.ts FrontmatterView interface ↔ src-tauri/src/corpus.rs FrontmatterView serde wire keys

keychainAllowedAccounts.sourceOfTruth: src-tauri/src/keychain.rs ALLOWED ↔ src/lib/tauri.ts SECRET_GEMINI_API_KEY + breve-runtime/scripts/keychainNames.ts ROTLI_RESEND_ACCOUNT

endpointLocality.sourceOfTruth: behavioral: src-tauri/src/chat.rs endpoint_is_local ↔ src/ai/guard.ts endpointIsLocal (independent implementations, fixture-aligned verdicts)
